get.summary: Re-execute a single query and stream the result out as a download.
get.description:
Rows are pulled chunk-at-a-time and encoded straight into the response
body, so peak memory stays flat regardless of result size. This is a
fresh execution, not a snapshot of what the browser buffered: data may
have changed between display and export. Only `csv` and `jsonl` are
supported; `jsonl` carries one object per line because a JSON array
cannot be appended to without backtracking.

Transport note: this route sits behind the session-header auth
middleware, so browsers fetch it with script (which can attach the
session header) and buffer the body before saving. A native anchor
download is not used because it cannot send the header, and passing the
session through the URL would leak it via history and logs.

RebuildFulltextIndexRequest.description:
Rebuild a fulltext index request.

The rebuild runs asynchronously: the handler returns a rebuild id
immediately and the caller polls the rebuild status endpoint.

RegisterFunctionRequest.description:
Registration function request.

Only `name` and `implementation` (local dynamic-library path) decide
registration. The remaining metadata fields are accepted for client
compatibility but ignored; the loaded library is the source of truth.

SearchStatsResponse.description: Search statistics response with per-index detail.

StreamQueryRequest.description:
Streaming query request (SSE `/stream` endpoint).

Single-statement mode uses `query`. Batch-streaming mode uses
`statements` (with shared `parameters` / `session_variables`, mirroring
[`BatchQueryRequest`]) and emits one `statement_begin` /
`statement_end` event pair per statement. The two modes are mutually
exclusive: a non-empty `query` together with non-empty `statements` is
rejected by the server.

fail_fast.description:
Stop the batch at the first failing statement (default true).
Already produced statements are kept either way.

parameters.description:
Query parameters bound to `@name` references in every statement
(batch-streaming mode only).

session_variables.description:
Session variables bound to `$name` references in every statement
(batch-streaming mode only). When omitted, the session-managed
snapshot is used, same as [`BatchQueryRequest`].

statements.description: Batch-streaming statements. Empty means single-statement mode.

SystemResourceResponse.description: System resource response with stable keys plus process and disk detail.

UpdateEdgeData.description: Edge update data (edge identity includes rank, unlike inserts)

UserListItem.description: User list entry for the management view.

estimated_rows.description:
Planner root-operator row estimate for automatic routing.
Absent when the statement is not stream-shaped or the plan
carries no estimate; callers treat a missing value as "stream".
